notes.title: The Big Pet Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone sorry for the long wait but we're finally releasing the big pet update! I'm really excited about the changes this update brings as I think it really focuses the game on what everyone has found the most fun; pets! Here's a list of what's new and what's changed.

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pet Station - Befriending your creatures will now make them residents of your planet instead of just being put away in storage. Residents will roam your planet and interact with one another. The Pet Station is where you can manage what pets you want to keep around. The storage is still there to keep any pets that overflow the station. Upgrades to the station size will be coming in a future update.
[*] Feeding - Feed your pets to increase the new PetPak level. There are no longer star levels for each PetPak but a level 1-100 for each slot on your pet. Without revealing too much, I can say that PetPaks now work on a whole new system. This means recipes have changed for PetPaks and so you will have to discover them all over again. Each pet whether befriended or hatched will have different comptabilities with different PetPaks. Feeding items and PetPaks will now show up in the indicator when you get close to pets.
[*] Eggs! - Get your pets to romance and lay an egg! Hatch the egg to get a pet that inherits traits from its parents. Certain pet colors can only be obtained through romancing!
[*] Pet Naming - You can now name your pets! Pet names can be a maximum of 12 characters.
[*] The Tutorial - The entire beginning of the game has changed to focus more on pets and the idea that building on your planet will attract more.
[*] Rain - There is a chance that you will get rain periodically. Rain will automatically water all of your crops.
[*] Virtual Keyboard - A custom virtual keyboard to help with all the issues we have been having with the Steam Deck. Official verified steam dec
[/list]k support to come soon.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] One True Grid - all of the items in the game now work on the same grid (buildings, crops, furniture, etc.) This will allow you to put machines in your home. Also this includes better position snapping for fences.
[*] Pet Visit Conditions - There are many more pet visit conditions than just planting crops. I'll leave these for you to figure out!
[*] Pets have animations for chopping down trees, smashing meteors, and sitting.
[*] Crops - The grow time for crops has been fixed so they no longer grow instantly. Crops will also now grow even while you're away from your planet. You will still need to water each growth stage.
[*] The minimap now shows you a live view so it's always up to date.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fashion Show - The camera will no longer turn black and you should be able to play the game normally.
[*] Planet color changes correctly when going to another player's planet
[*] Travel Fallback - when you connect to a planet code that doesn't exist the game now puts you back where you came from with a network error message.
[*] Camera app crash should now be fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Happy Easter! Patch Notes 4/20

- Planet Environments! - A new way to customize your planet. Find all the different colors after completing the new quest!

notes.title: Patch Notes 4/11 - CONTROLLER SUPPORT!!!
notes.content:
I spent the entire week working on controller support! I'm really excited for you all to try it and let me know what you think. There definitely will be some glitches here and there but I believe the game is 99% playable with the controller. I'll list what I covered below as well as some known glitches you might see.

[list]
[*] A pointer that looks just like the current mouse has been added so you can see what you're selecing
[*] Apps: Clothing, Tracker, Quests, etc. - Shoulder button switching added for navigation between tabs. Scrolling up and down will follow your pointer. 
[*] Fabricator, Blueprints, PetPak Mixer - Got the same treatment as above.
[*] Removed the out of place red X button from screens that had it. Added a quit button that shows the controller button you can use to exit back to the previous screen. It's also clickable.
[*] Game intro and Pet Encounter updated to work with controller.
[*] Button icons - Support has been added for Xbox (covers Steam Deck and other generic PC controllers), PlayStation, and Nintendo button icons.
[*] Minigames - Show the "How To Play" screen for each game with the Up D-Pad. Press Start to open settings and go back to HQ. Minigame results screens also updated to work with the pointer.
[*] Pet Deck - Selecting a card that's not your following pet will now swap it to the following position while using the controller.
[*] Pet Storage - Selecting a card in your storage will move the pet into your party and vice versa.
[/list]

Known Controller Glitches
[list]
[*] Sometimes when in a screen/window your pointer will highlight the hot bar. We're working on this fix but it shouldn't affect your ability to play the game.
[*] Clothing App Camera - Didn't have time work on this one completely. It partially works but definitely needs attention.
[*] Certain times when opening the clothing app the pointer won't show up until you change tabs.
[/list]

Other updates besides controller support!
[list]
[*] Dailies! - A bug with saving caused dailies to not appear for most people has been fixed. Everyone should get dailies now.
[*] Big fishing clean up! I cleaned up a ton of the code in fishing to hopefully clear up the buge we've been having. Please let me know if you continue to experience them! Or if there's new ones...
[*] Fix for the mystery man fishing quest so the fish he asks for don't change up.
[*] Removed the extra Trevally from the list of total fish.
[*] Mouths fixed - Finally figured out the bug that was causing the different mouths to not show up. Enjoy!
[*] Eri Tail fix
[*] Sprint is now a toggle. Press the sprint button to go into sprinting mode and press it again to go back to walking.
[/list]

Unfortunately I didn't get to any other fixes or content updates because of all the controller support work I did this week. Hopefully next week I'll be able to dive back in and start fixing bugs and adding new content!

notes.title: We made it... Early Access!
notes.content:
First off, thank you for joining us on this journey. Galactic Getaway is still in its early days, and while it’s not perfect (yet), we believe we’ve built a solid foundation for something truly special.

We’re a small team working tirelessly to bring this world to life. Which means there will be bugs. But that’s where you come in! If something breaks, if your cat glitches through a wall, or if you just have an idea that could make the game better we want to hear it. This isn’t just our game. It’s yours, too.

[h2]Some things to expect from us at the beginning of early access[/h2]
[list]
[*] Constant updates and bug fixes - We're going to do our best squash all the bugs that come our way. We've already updated the game 3 times since launch!
[*] Support - We are trying to be as active as possible with any issues in Discord and Steam.
[*] Controller/Steamdeck Support - This has been the #1 requested feature and we'll be working on this ASAP.
[*] Graphics settings - A highly requested feature from reviews, these settings should be in today.
[/list]

[h2]Some things we want to add to the game while in EA[/h2]
[list]
[*] More PetPaks - More ways for you to power up your pets and interact with the world.
[*] Pet Naming - Name your pets
[*] Pet Roaming - Have your pets roam your planet and do tasks for you
[*] Planet Rating Upgrades - More buildings and machines to build out your town with.
[*] Planet Customization - Make your planet red, green, or whatever you want!
[*] Material Machines - Machines to bring a wider variety materials to your planet
[*] Day/night cycle
[*] Planet Plot Expansion - Grow your town to be bigger and better!
[*] Minigames - More games to play with friends and other players.
[*] Pet Minigames - Possibly a minigames where you play as your pet
[*] HQ Hangouts - More buildings like cafes, clubs, or libraries for players to just hang out in
[*] Player Profiles - See other players and give them fame each day!
[*] Marriage - Get married to other players!
[*] Expanding on multiplayer tournaments and events
[/list]

We’re in this together, and we can’t wait to build Galactic Getaway with you. So suit up, explore, and remember every great space adventure starts with a few bumps along the way.

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/kTy7jyKdqG]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Early Access here we come!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that after 3 years in development, Galactic Getaway is going to be available in Early Access! 

We decided to take this jump because we truly believe the game is at point where it can benefit from growing along with the community. GG has incredibly flexible features and systems we can quickly build upon to incorporate player feedback. Here are some of the things you'll already be able to do in game:

[list]
[*] Receive your own planet with a native fruit and unique color
[*] Decorate your home and planet with tons of unique furniture.
[*] Customize your character with different eyes, hair, and clothes.
[*] Befriend 30 different pets in various colors by farming and decorating to discover what they like
[*] Craft different power ups for your creatures to help you work on your planet
[*] Meet with up to 60 people at once online in GG Headquarters to chat or play minigames
[*] Unlock achievements and daily Planeteer tasks to help you shape your planet
[*] Complete the storyline and have NPCs move into your planet for unique shops and abilities
[/list]

The features of the game; pets, farming, decorating, clothing, and minigames are all set up for full multiplayer. Which means they can be infinitely expanded on!

If you'd like to discuss with other people excited about the game please join our Discord: https://discord.gg/kTy7jyKdqG

Thank you so much for all of your support. We hope Galactic Getaway can be a game everyone and anyone can enjoy!

notes.title: Dev Log #2
notes.content:
Hello space cadets! This month we were really focused on fixing up feedback from alpha testers, getting the word out about the game, and working on the next phase of mechanics. Unfortunately there's still no estimate for the release of early access but we will keep you all updated right here. Read until the end of the update to learn how you can help get us there faster!

[h1]Updates[/h1]
So far a lot of the feedback from alpha testers has been bugs (of course) but also focused around usability and immersion. So alongside working on the new features for the game here are some things we added/fixed to better bring the user into the game.

[h2]Controls[/h2]
Our team plays a ton of different types of games so we made a lot of assumptions about the controls. For example, we thought a common control scheme was to hold the right mouse button to rotate the camera. However, a lot of testers who only play fixed camera games had no idea you could rotate the camera at all! On top of this it wasn't clear you could jump either. So we decided to make it so the camera rotates with your mouse and unlocks when you decide to open up your inventory or any menus. We also added a more in-depth controls tutorial to the beginning of the game.

[h2]Audio[/h2]
The music in the game was there but not having ambient sound was really breaking the immersion for some people. So we went in and added footstep audio based on the ground material (rock, grass, etc). This helped really cement our character into the world. We also changed the dialogue sound to be a bit more subtle so it wasn't as overwhelming listening to long stretches of dialogue.

Here's a few other things we worked on:
Settings: Camera sensitivity
World: Walk particles, Rework item stack system from ground up
UI: Rework all ui to feel smoother,New interact indication

[h2]Up Next[/h2]
This month we'll be focusing on extending and fully fleshing out our encounter mechanics. We really want to make it feel like you've befriended these creatures beyond just feeding them their favorite food. But balancing that so it's a relaxing experience has been challenging! We're hoping to have a few playtests this month with our alpha backers to fully flesh this system out. We've made a ton of new creatures that are just waiting to be snatched up!

[h1]Steam Page Revamp[/h1]
Currently, we're looking for a publisher to help us bring Galactic Getaway to the Nintendo Switch and in multiple languages. A publisher would also mean the game would get into your hands much faster. So we've really been working on ramping up our wishlists on Steam! We completely updated the description and spent time taking some screenshots we think really captures the essence of the game. Check them out on the Steam Page!

Your support can make the difference! By adding Galactic Getaway to your Steam wishlist, you’ll help us attract publishers and show that this game is something people are excited about.

Until next time! Love,
Daniel & the GG Team

notes.title: Dev Log #1
notes.content:
Hi space cadets! With how busy we've been between developing and keeping up with the Kickstarter, I haven't had a chance to update the steam page. I realized we're leaving a huge group of you out of the loop so moving forward I'm going to make sure to post updates here as well.

[h1]Change is a good thing[/h1]

The last few months have been really transformative for GG (Galactic Getaway). I'm grateful to all the backers of the Kickstarter but also heard the negative feedback as well. "Animal Crossing from Walmart", "This looks like a mod", etc. What I realized was that describing our game as  "Animal Crossing with better multiplayer" actually made our game lack identity.

"Galactic Getaway"- this is a game in space, right? In almost all of the screenshots I showed before, there was no way to tell GG took place in outer space. So we changed the artistic mood of the game. With bright purple terrain and starry skies, now it’s clear you’re on an Alien planet! We’ve also added alien crops, meteors to break, and crazy creatures to collect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43682528/58c68a83459b25d1aa16078733de9a3a2cfa9acd.png[/img]

Creatures? That's right, GG is officially a creature collector! But with an extra twist. Different creatures will be attracted to your planet when you farm crops, decorate your planet with furniture, and invite friends over. Spend time figuring out their favorite food, petting them, or maybe telling them a joke to have them join your team and unlock more ways to build your home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43682528/289ed05e36d76cbd76da47f2560992e489fb6dcb.png[/img]

[h1]Updates[/h1]

Last month’s alpha test was a huge success, with over 500 backers diving in and playing for up to 7 hours to 100% all of the creatures we have so far. This really gave me confidence that we're moving in the right direction with these changes. 

We've hit a few roadblocks that are going to impact the date of early access. Though I can't give you an exact date of when it will be available, I can say it won't be this month. We want to make sure we deliver something we're proud of and that's going to most likely take a few more months. Hopefully these new updates will ease anyone who's anxious about the progress of the game. If you have any questions don't hesitate to email or send a message in Discord.

I’m also looking for a publisher to bring Galactic Getaway to the Nintendo Switch and in multiple languages. Your support can make the difference! If you haven't already please add Galactic Getaway to your Steam wishlist, you’ll help us attract publishers and show that this game is something people are excited about.

Thank you and I look forward to posting more updates about our progress!

- Daniel Luu
Game Director

notes.title: We're launching our Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43682528/e97971b93e90e9b2cd7ecbce05bb6cf2309c93e8.png[/img]

I want to thank you for your continued support and love. I'm passionate about videogames, especially multiplayer games. When I first started playing Animal Crossing I was hoping it'd be something I could enjoy with my friends online. Turns out you can't decorate together, there are no co-op minigames, and you have to slowly watch as people try to leave your island. So I set out on a journey to make my own game.

Over the last 2 years a small team and I have been working hard at making the cozy game of our dreams, Galactic Getaway! You'll farm, tame pets, and explore an undiscovered planet with new and old friends. Team up to play a variety of mini-games or just hangout and build. I'm excited to announce that we’re officially launching our Kickstarter on [b]January 30th[/b].
